summary: Implements backup creation, listing, verification, and restoration operations via pg_dump and pg_restore wrappers.
reason: PostgreSQL backup/restore management is a core administrative feature. The implementation wraps pg_dump and pg_restore for atomic writes, format detection, selective restoration, and integrity verification.
validated_outcome: All backup subcommands (create, list, verify, restore) integrate with root command and pass unit tests. Format detection, file validation, and command structure verified.

backup_create.description: Create backups in custom, tar, or plaintext format with atomic writes and compression

backup_list.description: List existing backups with sizes, timestamps, and verification status

backup_verify.description: Validate backup integrity via pg_restore --list or test restore

backup_restore.description: Restore from backup with optional schema/data-only selective restore

test_coverage: Unit tests for format detection, file validation, command structure, and helper functions. Integration tests skipped (require PostgreSQL fixture).
